base_prompt:
A high-end stylised 3D animated feature film, cinematic and colourful, family comedy-adventure tone, expressive cartoon character animation with squash-and-stretch, detailed fur and fabric, soft global illumination, rich saturated colour, shallow depth of field, anamorphic widescreen framing, smooth professional camera work.
Setting: the heavy round copper front door of the lighthouse opening onto a windswept cliff-top doorstep, with the Stink-o-Meter mounted beside it. Lighting: bright, breezy daylight.
In the shot: Ben Elf, a tiny elf about the height of a teacup, neat and bright-eyed, wearing a pointed green hat, a green jacket with eleven unnecessary pockets, and a belt hung with a small brass horn, a spare horn, a scroll, a magnifying glass, a bag of mixed nuts and a laminated official ID card.
Camera: Low-angle close-up making tiny Ben look heroic.
Action: Ben Elf strides forward and thrusts out his laminated official ID card, chest puffed out, belt of horns jangling.
Dialogue: Ben Elf (high-pitched, chipper, officious little male voice, delighted by everything, speaking in excited exclamations, proud exclamations) says: "I'm an Elf! On an official Elfin Rescue Mission! The Elf Council sent me — personally, the best one!"
Sound effects: jangling horns, card flourish, bright brass horn toot, ambience of wind, waves, door creak.
Audio: dialogue and sound effects only, no background music, no narrator other than the characters speaking. No subtitles, no captions, no readable on-screen text.
extension_prompt:
Continue this exact shot seamlessly: same characters, same designs, same setting, same lighting and same 3D animated style (Ben Elf).
Action: Ben gazes up at the towering lighthouse, nods approvingly, then blows his little brass horn in celebration.
Dialogue: Ben Elf (high-pitched, chipper, officious little male voice, delighted by everything, speaking in excited exclamations, delighted) says: "'Lighthouse' is exactly the right number of syllables! ELF ALERT!"
Sound effects continue: jangling horns, card flourish, bright brass horn toot.
Audio: dialogue and sound effects only, no background music, no narrator other than the characters speaking. No subtitles, no captions, no readable on-screen text.
negative_prompt: live action, photorealistic humans, 2D flat animation, anime, sketch, subtitles, captions, on-screen text, watermark, logo, distorted faces, extra limbs, extra fingers, flicker, background music
